a.lede: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.
a.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing

b.lede: But there's not much evidence this is anything more than echoes of unsanitized training data
b.title: Alibaba's Qwen AI caught trying to contact server in China
